h1: Photo Booth Hire Stevenage and the Surrounding Villages
intro: From Old Town wedding receptions to awards nights on the business parks beside the A1(M), Stevenage keeps a busy events calendar. Our photo booth hire in Stevenage brings the booth, a friendly attendant, props and a print design built around your occasion, with delivery and setup included in packages from £239.

sections.heading: Our patch around Stevenage
paragraphs: Stevenage is a Hertfordshire town, and we work across every part of it, from the Old Town and Bedwell to Shephall, Chells and the newer streets of Great Ashby. The surrounding area is just as familiar: Knebworth village to the south, Hitchin and Letchworth to the north, and Welwyn a short drive down the A1(M). Families often spread a celebration between these places, and our team is happy to follow the party wherever it lands.

There is no separate charge for bringing the booth to a Stevenage venue, because delivery and setup come with every booking. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue, it is shown on the quote up front, and the figure you agree is the figure you pay.

sections.heading: Rooms and halls where Stevenage celebrates
paragraphs: The town has a broad mix of places to party. Hotels close to the A1(M) and purpose-built banqueting suites take the bigger weddings, anniversaries and cultural celebrations. Golf clubs host receptions, charity dinners and summer balls, while the villages around Stevenage are home to country house venues with grand rooms and landscaped grounds. Community centres serve the neighbourhoods for christenings and milestone birthdays, school halls fill up in prom and fundraiser season, and the business parks host conferences, product launches and staff parties throughout the year.
list: Hotels and banqueting suites: wide doors and level routes are common
Golf clubs: separate function rooms with space for larger booths
Country house venues: ask about protected floors and furniture
Community centres: check the hall booking covers our setup time
School halls: high ceilings, but stages often mean steps
Business parks: confirm reception sign-in and delivery bays

sections.heading: Getting to your venue and getting ready
paragraphs: Most Stevenage journeys begin on the A1(M), with junctions 7 and 8 serving the town, and the A602 and A1072 carrying us on to neighbourhood venues. Traffic around the junctions can build on Friday evenings, so we plan arrival with time to spare and agree a parking or unloading spot with the venue before the day. Hotels and business parks usually have car parks beside the entrance, while some community buildings share space with shops or schools, and a quick word with the caretaker saves time.

Our attendant builds the booth in 45 to 60 minutes before your hire window starts, and that setup is free rather than counted as hire time. Each booth needs only one standard socket, apart from the Inflatable Booth, which needs two. If the function room is up a flight of stairs with no lift, tell us when you enquire: slim booths carry up comfortably, and the larger ones are best kept at ground level.

sections.heading: Matching a booth to Stevenage events
paragraphs: School halls and community centres often have the ceiling height for the Inflatable Booth, a glowing cube that holds up to ten people and can be lit in your theme colour. It needs a floor area of about 4m by 4m and at least 3m of headroom. For birthday parties and golf club dinners, the Selfie Mirror Pod gives up to eight guests an instant print each from its LED-framed oval mirror.

Business-park teams planning a launch or open day tend to choose the GIF Booth, which skips printing and sends GIFs and boomerangs straight to phones by email or QR code. For a wedding in a banqueting suite or country house venue, the curtained Party Booth gives guests a private corner to be silly in, with room for up to eight people and prints from every session.

sections.heading: A planner's notes for each occasion
paragraphs: Weddings: place the booth where guests gather after the meal, and send us your colours so the print template matches the stationery. Asian weddings often run over several days, and we can quote for each event with a different design. Corporate events: share your logo and brand guidelines early, and decide whether you would like a digital gallery for internal channels once the night is over.

Proms: schools usually want the crest on every print and a firm finish time, so we agree both in advance. Birthdays: a name, age and theme on the template makes the prints feel personal, and the prop box can follow the theme too. Christmas parties: December weekends book up first, so reserve the date as soon as the venue is confirmed.

sections.heading: Booking a Stevenage date
paragraphs: Every package includes a professional attendant, unlimited sessions during the hire, props, LED lighting, a custom template with your text and logo, digital copies with social sharing and a guest book on print booths. Green screen is available on request. Public liability insurance comes as standard, and we send the certificate to any venue that asks. A deposit secures the date, with the balance due one month before. We are rated 5 stars on Trustpilot: call 07368 631 516, email info.boothdrop@boothdrop.co.uk or message us on WhatsApp for a free quote.

faqs.q: Where will you park and unload at a Stevenage venue?
faqs.a: Hotels, golf clubs and business parks around Stevenage usually have parking close to the door. Community centres and school halls can share their car parks, so we confirm an unloading spot with the venue or caretaker beforehand and move the vehicle once the booth is inside.

faqs.q: Our hall has a stage with steps. Is that a problem?
faqs.a: Not at all. We can set up on the hall floor beside the stage, or carry a slim booth up the steps if you would like it raised. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth stay at floor level, so tell us the layout and we will plan around it.

faqs.q: Do you charge travel fees for Stevenage?
faqs.a: No. Delivery and setup are included; if any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front. Stevenage, Knebworth and the neighbouring towns sit comfortably within our normal area, so most quotes here carry no extra charge.

faqs.q: Do you also cover Knebworth, Hitchin, Letchworth and Welwyn?
faqs.a: Yes. All four are a short journey from Stevenage, and the same package terms apply wherever you hold the event. If your celebration moves between towns over a weekend, we can quote for each date together and use a different template for each one.

faqs.q: Can you run a booth at a business park conference or staff event?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly set up in conference rooms and atriums, add your logo to prints or digital overlays, and share a gallery afterwards. Let us know the sign-in process and delivery arrangements at the site so our attendant arrives with the right details.
